description: This source file implements functions related to ordering objects and diff files, including reading an order file, matching paths, comparing object orderings, and reordering collections of objects and diffs based on a specified order. It is part of a version control system's diff processing, specifically handling custom ordering logic.

methods.name: void prepare_order(const char * orderfile)
methods.description: Reads an order file, processes its lines, and populates the global order array with the paths specified in the order file, skipping comments and blank lines.

methods.name: int match_order(const char * path)
methods.description: Matches a given path against the ordered patterns, returning the index in the order array that best matches the path.

methods.name: int compare_objs_order(const void * a_,const void * b_)
methods.description: Comparison function used for qsort to order objects based on their specified order and original position.

methods.name: void order_objects(const char * orderfile,obj_path_fn_t obj_path,struct obj_order * objs,int nr)
methods.description: Main function to order an array of objects according to the specified order file, using provided object path function.

methods.name: const char * pair_pathtwo(void * obj)
methods.description: Helper function that returns the path associated with a diff filepair.

methods.name: void diffcore_order(const char * orderfile)
methods.description: Reorders diff queue objects according to the order specified in the order file.

ctags.signature: (const char * orderfile,obj_path_fn_t obj_path,struct obj_order * objs,int nr)
